running_recovery.required_operator_action: Inspect provider and Hyper-V readback for the operation, then reconcile manually before considering a new mutation.

timeout_policy.deadline_result: An observation that reaches its deadline is inconclusive; it must not trigger automatic retry.

expected_before: vm.list has no row for the requested name
requested VM root and VHD path are absent or owned by no prior create
expected_after: vm.list has a managed-by-purecvisor-desktop-node row
generation is 2
requested CPU and startup memory are present
expected VHD and Default Switch attachments are present
operation_families.idempotency_basis: A second create is safe only when the complete expected post-state and owned artifact identity are proven; a partial VHD/VM create is not safe to replay.
operation_families.timeout_policy: current-route-timeout-v1; no new worker deadline in Wave 2B
operation_families.operator_action: Preserve the interrupted job and inspect VM inventory plus owned VM-root/VHD artifacts. Do not submit a second create until complete absence or an approved manual cleanup decision is recorded.
future_2c_gate: persist before-state or equivalent unique operation identity

expected_before: vm.list has a managed VM row
expected_after: vm.list has no row for the VM name
delete-status can report the latest job without asserting external exactly-once
operation_families.idempotency_basis: The native adapter already represents a missing VM as action=absent, but absence alone cannot distinguish a delete that completed from one that never started without before-state evidence.
operation_families.timeout_policy: current-route-timeout-v1; no new worker deadline in Wave 2B
operation_families.operator_action: Confirm the VM was managed, capture absent inventory, retain the job evidence, and only then choose the existing operator retry/recovery procedure. Never delete an unmanaged VM.
future_2c_gate: terminal result mapping that preserves absent-versus-unknown

expected_before: old VM name exists and is managed
expected_after: old VM name is absent
new VM name exists with the managed marker
the requested new_name matches
operation_families.idempotency_basis: The provider verifies the target after rename, but the current job row does not persist a stable pre-rename identity; a new-name row alone is insufficient if the pre-state was not captured.
operation_families.timeout_policy: current-route-timeout-v1; no new worker deadline in Wave 2B
operation_families.operator_action: Read both old and new names, verify managed ownership and retain the interrupted job. If both names or neither name are present, stop and resolve manually; do not rename again.
future_2c_gate: stable VM identity or persisted before-state

expected_before: current IOPS or Kbps policy is known
expected_after: target policy equals requested minimum/maximum values
VM remains addressable
operation_families.idempotency_basis: The mutation provider captures previous/applied policy only in a completed result. Current public blkio/bandwidth readback exposes storage/network inventory, not the QoS policy values needed to prove a persisted-running mutation.
readback_sources: hyperv-qos-mutation-apply-evidence.v1 when a terminal result exists
operation_families.timeout_policy: current-route-timeout-v1; no new worker deadline in Wave 2B
operation_families.operator_action: Do not retry or roll back from the job row. Use provider-specific administrative readback to establish the actual policy, then apply an approved rollback or set operation manually and record evidence.
future_2c_gate: typed QoS policy readback for both disk and network

expected_before: restore requires the named checkpoint to exist
expected_after: create: named checkpoint exists
delete: named checkpoint is absent
restore: named checkpoint remains and VM state/data matches the restored snapshot
operation_families.idempotency_basis: create and delete have observable name presence, but current job parameters do not persist the before-state; restore cannot be proven from checkpoint presence alone because the VM's restored data/state is not exposed by checkpoint.list.
readback_sources: provider-specific VM state/data inspection for restore
operation_families.timeout_policy: current-route-timeout-v1; no new worker deadline in Wave 2B
operation_families.operator_action: For create/delete, capture checkpoint presence and the original job parameters but do not blindly repeat. For restore, stop processing and use a provider-specific inspection before any further mutation.
future_2c_gate: restore post-state readback and actual-VM evidence

expected_before: managed VM exists with a known state
expected_after: start/resume: state=running
poweroff: state=stopped
pause: state=paused
operation_families.idempotency_basis: vm.list exposes the target state, but a persisted-running row lacks a durable before-state and a state match does not prove which invocation caused it.
operation_families.timeout_policy: current-route-timeout-v1; no new worker deadline in Wave 2B
operation_families.operator_action: Capture current VM state and preserve the interrupted job. Do not issue the same power operation again unless an operator confirms the prior side effect is absent or safely idempotent.

expected_before: shutdown requires a usable integration service; restart may reset a running or transitional VM
expected_after: shutdown: guest and VM state are stopped
restart: VM has completed a new running transition
operation_families.idempotency_basis: Guest shutdown and reset can complete outside the process response boundary; vm.list state alone cannot prove guest acknowledgement or reset completion.
operation_families.timeout_policy: current-route-timeout-v1; no new worker deadline in Wave 2B
operation_families.operator_action: Inspect VM state and guest integration health. Do not repeat shutdown or restart while the prior external transition is uncertain.
future_2c_gate: guest shutdown acknowledgement or reset correlation

expected_before: managed VM and target resource exist
current resource value is known for the requested field
expected_after: set-memory/set-vcpu: vm.list values match
limit/disk-resize/eject: target-specific post-state is proven by a dedicated provider readback
operation_families.idempotency_basis: vm.list can observe startup memory and CPU, while current disk inventory omits reliable size and DVD eject state and vm.limit has no matching public limit readback.
operation_families.timeout_policy: current-route-timeout-v1; no new worker deadline in Wave 2B
operation_families.operator_action: Use field-specific provider readback. Treat any missing resource field as unknown and do not repeat the mutation from the failed job row.
future_2c_gate: typed readback for each resource field

expected_before: credential reference, audit, timeout and RBAC gates must be open
expected_after: guest command/channel terminal state and audit record are correlated
operation_families.idempotency_basis: Guest execution can have an external guest-side effect and is explicitly excluded from automatic retry/reconciliation in Wave 2B.
operation_families.timeout_policy: guest timeout_sec remains 1-600 seconds for its separate ADR-0009 design; Wave 2B adds no guest behavior
operation_families.operator_action: Keep the job non-retryable and follow ADR-0009/Guest Execution evidence procedure; do not enable or replay it from this decision table.
